vague: The team will do better next quarter.
hint: Better at what? Name the number and the date.
sharp_example: By 31 December 2026, the team will have closed at least 40 sales.

hint: How much more than what? Soon is when?
sharp_example: By the end of March 2027, monthly sales will be at least 10% above March 2026.

vague: The weather will be nice this weekend.
hint: Nice is a feeling. Which reading would settle it?
sharp_example: On Saturday 6 February 2027, the high in Seattle will be at least 12 degrees Celsius.

vague: My boss will be happy with the report.
hint: Happy is inside someone's head. What could a stranger see?
sharp_example: By Friday, my boss will have replied to the report with written approval.

vague: The new law will have a big impact.
hint: Big compared with what? Pick something that can be counted.
sharp_example: By 1 January 2028, at least 1,000 firms will have registered under the new law.

hint: Eventually never ends. Pick the date and the price.
sharp_example: By June 2027, the price of a one-litre bottle of milk in my shop will be higher than it is today.

vague: The match will probably be close.
hint: Probably is a probability: say it with the number later. What does close mean?
sharp_example: On Sunday, the match will be decided by one goal or fewer.

vague: The company will do much better this year.
hint: Better at what? Revenue? Say which number.
sharp_example: By 31 December 2027, the company's annual revenue will exceed its 2026 revenue.

vague: Traffic on the bridge will get worse.
hint: Worse by what measure? Which day and hour?
sharp_example: On Monday morning, the 8 am drive across the bridge will take longer than 30 minutes.

vague: The launch will be a success.
hint: Success is a judgment. What count would a stranger accept?
sharp_example: By 1 March 2027, the launch page will have at least 5,000 sign-ups.

hint: Up or down, and by when? A claim that fits everything says nothing.
sharp_example: By 31 March 2027, the central bank's policy rate will be below its current level.

hint: Well is not a result. What will exist, and by when?
sharp_example: By 30 June 2027, the project will have shipped its first release to customers.
